Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add MapSplat plugin scaffold \(v0.1.1\)

New QGIS plugin for exporting projects to static web maps using
PMTiles format and MapLibre GL JS.

Features:
- Dockable widget UI with layer selection
- Export pipeline: GeoPackage → PMTiles via ogr2ogr
- Style converter for single symbol, categorized, graduated renderers
- HTML viewer generation with click-to-identify popups
- Auto-reprojection to EPSG:3857 \(Web Mercator\)
- Style.json export/import for Maputnik roundtripping

Renamed from ''po'' \(Publish Online\) to ''mapsplat''.

Documentation:
- PLAN.md: Development roadmap and architecture
- TODO.md: Prioritized task list
- CHANGELOG.md: Version history
- README.md: User documentation
- REQUIREMENTS.md: Technical specifications
- VIABILITY.md: Feasibility assessment

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Qt6/QGIS 4.0 compatibility \(v0.1.2\)

Fixes for compatibility with both QGIS 3.x \(Qt5\) and QGIS 4.x \(Qt6\):

- QAction import: moved from QtWidgets to QtGui in Qt6
- Qt enum scoping changes:
  - Qt.RightDockWidgetArea → Qt.DockWidgetArea.RightDockWidgetArea
  - Qt.ItemIsEnabled → Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
  - Qt.UserRole → Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole
  - QListWidget.MultiSelection → QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.MultiSelection

Uses try/except blocks to maintain backwards compatibility with Qt5.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
